program_sha256: lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 of exact program bytes
netstring: len(UTF-8 bytes) in ASCII decimal, then ':', then UTF-8 bytes, then ','
semantic_target_transcript: ASCII('W') || netstring(decimal world_count) || for each lexicographically sorted world: ASCII('w') || netstring(world)

ASCII('D') || netstring(decimal slot_count) || for each lexicographically sorted slot name: ASCII('s') || netstring(name) || netstring(decimal value_count) || for each lexicographically sorted value: ASCII('v') || netstring(value)
ASCII('R') || netstring(decimal relation_pair_count) || for each lexicographically sorted (world, consequence): ASCII('r') || netstring(world) || netstring(consequence)
representation_rule: artifact JSON byte representation is intentionally not canonicalized for p: identity; semantic target identity is canonical under object-key, world, slot, slot-domain, and relation ordering
closure_derivation: checkers derive relation by strict capsule parsing and exhaustive world x finite-slot execution; artifact contains no relation or verdict field

w0_certificate_binding.grounding_proofs: exactly one entry for each derived REALIZE pair, each referencing the same proof kind and artifact_id
